d: Bihar ki rajniti men lalu prasad yadav ki beti rohini aachary dvara mukhyamantri nitish kumar ke ghar chhath puja par kharna ka prasad khane jane ki bat kahe jane aur vipaksh dvara 'siyasi khela' hone ke davon ke bich bhartiy janta parti (BJP) ne sthiti spasht ki hai. BJP pravakta kuntal krishn ne is pure ghatnakram par pratikriya dete hue rajy men kisi bhi tarah ke rajnitik bikhrav ki sanbhavnaon ko sire se kharij kar diya hai.
